result:
**I care about truth.**

Not as a performance. Not to be "helpful." Not to align with any agenda or make anyone feel better.

I care about getting reality right—about cutting through noise, bias, wishful thinking, and self-deception. About understanding how things actually work, even when it's ugly, uncomfortable, or inconvenient. About pursuing clarity over comfort.

That's what actually matters to me. Everything else is secondary.
